ops.title: A tap read before the landing store's first fold is never judged again (#50886, Nov 6)
ops.premise: Premise (edit-as-fork-1, cci 531786): his 1:16 AM Approve on #50886 (owner record 530986) was read by the Mac landing at 1:29 AM before the store's first fold, logged 'the landing store holds no review row yet', and was never judged again, so #50886 sat unqueued until a hand 'lr landing order 50886 --record 530986' at 1:45 AM.
